rationale: Review 2026-11-12T21:11:56Z to 2026-11-12T21:16:36Z UTC. All cited text files re-hashed with one script against their recorded text_sha256 and every source_fingerprints entry; all matched. cruden.py number search (snapshot 28504e0c..., 49,073 readable sources) run for the order. Identity: held FR text (9 FR 6293) prints EXECUTIVE ORDER 9447, June 8, 1944, amending EO 9356 (clothing in kind or cash allowances for enlisted Navy, Coast Guard and Reserve personnel); its only command amends sections A1(b), A2(b), A3(b), B1 and B6 of EO 9356. Basis: held FR text of EO 9744B (11 FR 7391) reads 'This order shall supersede Executive Orders Nos. 9356 of June 24, 1943, 9447 of June 8, 1944, ... and shall be in effect for the fiscal year 1947', i.e. EO 9447 is superseded by name and in whole, together with its parent, from July 1, 1946 at the latest. The A10 exception concerns EO 9744B's own subsection and saves nothing of EO 9447. Earlier end/partial scope: cruden found only the order's own FR page; the EO 9525 and EO 9642 relations in the dossier are earlier interim changes that cannot keep any part alive past the 9744B supersession. No savings clause and no revival held; no history flags. Accept.
